name: RhfForm
description: Provide RHF context, prevent native validation and focus the first invalid Glass UX field after submission.
signature: <T extends FieldValues, C = unknown, O extends FieldValues = T>({ form, onSubmit, onError, children, ...props }: RhfFormProps<T, C, O>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: FormStack, bound fields and submit controls.

props.name: form
props.description: RHF instance created with useForm, usually spreading rhfFormBehaviour.

props.name: onError
props.description: Receives an exception thrown by onSubmit. Render save feedback in the initiating control.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
